utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it — I’ll share the repair drive invite with everyone and follow up on the meeting spot as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — appreciate it. I’m finalizing the job list now, so send the meeting spot when you have it and I’ll pass along the assignments.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the meeting spot as soon as I hear back and keep everyone in the loop on the assignments too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. We still need help sorting tools and organizing the sign-up list, so I’ll keep things ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can help sort the tools and tidy the sign-up list when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me — I’m flexible, so just pick a time that fits the school schedule. I’ll bring the gloves and tools kit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll check the school schedule and pick a time that avoids pickup and drop-off. Thanks for bringing the gloves and tools kit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about Saturday morning volunteers, especially anyone handy with tools. Looking forward to the supply list when you stop by later.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare, plus extra hands if they’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Vik — I’ll keep it going and let folks know we could still use a few more hands for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I checked the shed and found a few usable tools I can spare. Just let me know the drop-off details, and I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. Could you tell me which tools you’re bringing and when you can drop them off so I can keep the list straight?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hand drill, a set of screwdrivers, and a couple of wrenches I can bring by. I can drop them off tomorrow afternoon if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — do you know the exact meeting spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m still confirming the exact spot, Opal, but I’ll send it as soon as I have it. In the meantime, I’m keeping the repair list sorted by housing-blocking first, then safety, then smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — that sorting makes sense. Please send the exact meeting spot as soon as you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — I’ve got your priority noted. I’ll make sure the front door latch comes first, and I’ll ask about the kitchen sink if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — that sounds right. Please keep me posted if the sink can wait, and I’ll handle the rest of the repair drive setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll keep you posted if the sink has to wait. Thanks for handling the setup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—just point me to the repair drive and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll pull together the supplies list so we can see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — send me the list when you have it, and I’ll check the repair drive for anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly my front door latch — it’s been sticking for weeks. If there’s time, I’d also love a quick look at the kitchen sink.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Nell — I think we can get the latch looked at first, and if there’s time, the sink too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess—you’re really okay taking a look at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Kira—I’m happy to help keep track of it. I’ll share the drop-off details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — just let me know the drop-off details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — I’m still gathering the supply list, and we could use a few more tool-savvy volunteers for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’m still sorting the details, but I can help once the list is set and you know what tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Uli — I’ll bring the supply list by later, and we can match it up with whatever tools you can lend.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Leo—just point me to the list when it’s ready, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — I’ll bring the list, tape, marker, and boxes, and I’ll get there a bit early so we can sort.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, Leo — that sounds like a solid start. I’ll be ready when you get here, and I’m happy to pitch in with the sorting.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
